_comment: Per-org disclaimer copy for TCPA, e-sign, and payment-authorization blocks. Defaults apply to all orgs; by_org overrides specific orgs. Workflow + locale axes carry forward as we localize.
_source: BlinkerLegacy/blinker/app/views/partner/quote/contact.html.erb:128-138 (TCPA fallback default — no per-org overrides exist in legacy yet; the per-org TODO at partner/quotes_controller.rb:47-49 is unimplemented). E-sign + payment-auth blocks are NEW canon scaffolding; copy lives in legacy templates that haven't been extracted yet.
_principle: Disclaimer copy is per-org configurable but defaults to a single shared block per disclaimer kind. Read pattern: `orgDisclaimers.by_org[orgId]?.<kind>?.<locale> ?? orgDisclaimers.defaults.<kind>.<locale>`. The `{{ORG_NAME}}` and `{{WORKFLOW_NAME}}` placeholders are interpolated at render time by the consumer. Phase 2 swaps to `await blinkerApi.orgs.get(orgId).disclaimers` returning the same shape.

_shape.tcpa_consent: string — Required. SMS/call/email autodialer consent. Rendered above any contact-info-collecting CTA (typically billing or first-touch capture).
_shape.e_sign_consent: string — Required for any agreement-signing flow. Rendered above the DocuSeal embed or any signature capture.
_shape.payment_authorization: string — Required for billing screens. Rendered alongside the card-entry form. Authorizes recurring debit per the months-to-pay schedule.

tcpa_consent.en: By providing my contact information and clicking Continue, I consent to receive autodialed and prerecorded marketing calls, texts, and emails from {{ORG_NAME}}, its partners, and third-party service providers at the phone number and email I have provided above, even if on a state or federal Do Not Call registry. Consent is not a condition of purchase or credit approval. Message and data rates may apply. I can opt out at any time.

e_sign_consent.en: _TODO — extract from legacy DocuSeal template wrapper. By signing electronically, I agree that my electronic signature has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature.

payment_authorization.en: _TODO — extract from legacy packages/payment template. I authorize {{ORG_NAME}} to charge the payment method above for the down payment due today and for the recurring monthly payments per the schedule shown.
